title: Executive summary
scope: Covered: The Venetian (DeepStack Extravaganza IV, official schedule rows Nov 16 – Dec 23, 2026) and Wynn Las Vegas (daily tournaments and WPT World Championship, Nov 27 – Dec 21, 2026). Not covered: other Strip rooms. Every value is from an official source or is marked UNVERIFIED.

headline_numbers.label: Structure sheet silent on re-entry (The Venetian)
headline_numbers.note: One-day events Nov 18 - Dec 23, 2026 whose official structure sheet was read in full and prints no re-entry, rebuy or add-on clause. Silence is NOT a published freezeout rule: no Venetian sheet states "no re-entry", so these are sheet-silent, not confirmed single-entry.

headline_numbers.label: Excluded rows
headline_numbers.note: Re-entry, rebuy, add-on, multi-flight and satellite events. Shown in a separate section.

headline_numbers.label: Unverified rows (structure not reviewed)
headline_numbers.note: Official schedule values only; re-entry status unknown.

headline_numbers.label: Structure sheet silent on re-entry at Wynn
headline_numbers.note: Every Wynn structure sheet read prints an explicit re-entry clause, so none is even sheet-silent.

headline_numbers.label: Earliest verified single-entry start
headline_numbers.note: No verified single-entry event starts at 8:00 AM.

findings.title: Best single-entry value at The Venetian
findings.text: Ranked by official guarantee ÷ buy-in (computed): Event 36, $800 Bounty, $75K guarantee, Wed Dec 9 at 11:10 AM (93.75×); Event 54, $600 Bounty, $50K, Wed Dec 16 at 11:10 AM (83.33×); Event 52, $1,100 PKO, $75K, Tue Dec 15 at 11:10 AM (68.18×). Bounty guarantees include bounty money.

findings.title: Venetian house fee
findings.text: Official structure sheets state the house fee for each buy-in (for example $58 of $300, $90 of $600, $100 of $800, $130 of $1,100). The prize pool share is therefore about 80–88% of the buy-in for the verified single-entry events.

findings.title: Wynn daily events are not single-entry
findings.text: The official daily structure sheets allow re-entry on the Mon–Thu, Sat–Sun and nightly events, and rebuys and an add-on on the Friday event. These are excluded, even though the official poster does not mention re-entry.

findings.title: Wynn WPT events are unverified
findings.text: Only the general terms of the WPT structures PDF have been read. The remaining sections are not reviewed, so the WPT rows are either UNVERIFIED or excluded by event name (multi-flight or satellite).

findings.title: No 8:00 AM start can be confirmed
findings.text: The earliest verified sheet-silent (single-entry candidate) event starts at 10:10 AM: the $200 NLH RaceDay Stack on Nov 19, 20 and 21 and the $600 Seniors on Dec 2 (structure sheet 18 and 17, both read). The earliest start anywhere in the dataset is 9:00 AM — the Horseshoe daily No-Limit Hold'em — but that room publishes no buy-in, guarantee or entry rule, so it is an unverified row, not a candidate. No official schedule read for this dataset prints an 8:00 AM tournament, so an 8:00 AM start cannot be planned from verified events.

findings.title: Days with two or more verified single-entry events
findings.text: 14 of the 31 dated days in the dataset have two or more sheet-silent (single-entry candidate) events. The common shape is a 10:10 AM or 11:10 AM event plus a 5:10 PM event. A two-event day is therefore possible on those 14 days, but the gap between them is NOT verified: no official structure sheet states an expected finish time, so overlap is flagged as unknown rather than assumed to fit.

findings.title: Hotel resort fees are verified; room rates are not
findings.text: Both resorts charge a resort fee of $55 plus tax per night. Applying the 13.38% county room tax from The Venetian's terms gives about $62.36, a computed figure with an assumption to confirm. No official nightly rate was captured, so no true nightly cost is shown.

findings.title: Walking distance is unverified
findings.text: No walking time between any hotel and any poker room has been verified from an official source, so the 30-minute walking limit cannot be confirmed for any row.

recommendation: Use The Venetian's verified single-entry events as the starting point, prioritising the 11:10 AM and 5:10 PM events. Before any booking, answer the open questions (travel dates, nightly rates, walking times and poker-room confirmation) and decide on the suggestions.
